info.title: fleet-partner-service — Section 29 Reliability, Observability and Operational Readiness
info.description: Liveness, readiness, protected metrics, and the platform-scoped operational surface (backlog visibility, dead-lettered outbox record replay) added by Section 29. Business-domain routes are documented in their own section's OpenAPI file; this file covers only the operational surface this section adds or extends.

get.summary: Process liveness only. Never checks a dependency (database, Redis, or any external service) by design — see docs/section29-reliability-observability.md's Liveness section.
Identical to /live, preserved for any existing caller already pointed at this path.

Mandatory-dependency readiness. Returns 503 when any enabled, mandatory dependency is unavailable; disabled features never contribute a check. Never exposes a credential or raw internal error — only a dependency name and 'unavailable'.
Prometheus-style text exposition of every bounded-label metric this service records. Protected by a static bearer-style auth token (FLEET_PARTNER_METRICS_AUTH_TOKEN); never public.
Platform-wide job and outbox backlog/staleness snapshot — the same figures /ready gates on (job_stale_leases, job_dead_letter_backlog, outbox_backlog), exposed for on-demand operator inspection.

403.description: Caller is not on the internal worker-operations allowlist.

post.summary: Replay exactly one DEAD_LETTERED outbox record back to PENDING, by ID. Never a bulk/blind replay-everything operation — mirrors the existing per-job retry route's scope.

403.description: Caller is not on the internal worker-operations allowlist.

404.description: Record does not exist or is not currently DEAD_LETTERED.

503.description: The outbox repository is not configured in this deployment.

internalServiceAuth.name: X-Service-Signature
internalServiceAuth.description: HMAC service-to-service signature (shared/go/serviceauth) plus caller allowlist (WORKER_OPERATIONS_ALLOWED_CALLERS).
